latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ai-3d-rendering-openapi-skill.

- Transform any photo into a Blender-style 3D model viewport screenshot.
- Requires a WeShop API key for authentication (must be used only with openapi.weshop.ai).
- Supports image upload, status polling, and custom 3D rendering instructions.
- Offers batch processing (up to 16 images per request).
- Detailed security guidance for handling API keys safely.
